notes: FieldView keeps explicit null distinct from absent; null presence and fill fall back to null_semantics.ini; casts accept ASCII digits only; planner is Dijkstra over (schema, field state) with cost then edge-id-list tie-break, checking prerequisites on the state reached; executor applies pinned corrections on first arrival and checks prerequisites before every edge; pipeline orders by received_seq then line, keys replay identity on the canonical partner, makes the first partner-resolved record the holder, matches null tokens exactly and computes receipts from the parsed lines as received.
